title: Hybrid CNN–Transformer framework with attention-integrated feature interaction for kidney stone presence detection and coarse localization in CT images
desc: Accurate detection of kidney stones from computed tomography (CT) images is important for early diagnosis and efficient clinical assessment. This work presents a hybrid CNN–Transformer framework with attention-integrated feature interaction for kidney stone presence detection and coarse localization in CT images. The task is formulated as a coarse localization problem using simplified image-level bounding box annotations rather than precise lesion-level detection. The proposed framework employs a ResNet-101 backbone to extract fine-grained local features, while an Attention-Integrated Feature Interaction (AIFI) module facilitates interaction between local feature representations and global contextual information. A RepC3-based multi-scale feature fusion strategy is incorporated to aggregate hierarchical features across different spatial resolutions, enabling consistent feature representation under varying imaging conditions. In addition, a Real-Time Detection Transformer (RT-DETR) head is utilized for end-to-end prediction. Experimental evaluation on a publicly available CT kidney stone dataset demonstrates that the proposed framework achieves a mAP@0.5 of 99.5% with high precision and recall under the simplified annotation setting. The results indicate reliable performance for kidney stone presence detection and coarse spatial localization of stone-containing regions. However, the reported performance should be interpreted within the limitations of the simplified annotation strategy and relatively limited dataset size. Further validation using larger multi-center datasets with precise lesion-level annotations is required to establish broader generalizability and clinical applicability.
